name: Service choices persist after revisiting Business
description: Core service, area, differentiator, business model, and primary action stay intact across form navigation.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /onboard/, use manual entry, complete required Business fields, and continue
On Services enter two fictional services, one area, one differentiator, select Remote or online service, and select Request a quote
Use Back to revisit Business, then Continue to Services
Both service lines, the area, differentiator, Remote or online service choice, and Request a quote choice remain selected
